records.award_amount_text: $1,000 a year, renewable for four years
records.renewal_requirements: 3.0 cumulative GPA at Oregon Tech; remain an engineering or engineering technology major; at least 12 Oregon Tech credits per term.
records.eligibility_summary: New students majoring in engineering who are eligible for any of the four Presidential Scholarship awards.
records.major_requirement: For All New Students Majoring in Engineering … Student's eligible for any of the four presidential scholarship awards and majoring in engineering are also eligible for an Engineering Scholarship of $1,000 a year, renewable for four years. Students must maintain a 3.0 to keep their scholarship. … The Engineering Honors Scholarship is for fall, winter and spring terms for four years as long as a 3.0 cumulative GPA is maintained at Oregon Tech and the recipient remains an engineering or engineering technology major. Recipients must carry at least 12 Oregon Tech credits per term. Transfer students must have at least 36 quarter hours of transferable college credit. Applicants with fewer than 36 credits are considered on the basis of their college grades, high school record and test scores.
records.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-05: Oregon Tech scholarship page ties the award to engineering majors (renewal names engineering or engineering technology majors); linked to every Oregon Tech bachelor program whose printed name contains "Engineering". Source document sha256 4aaa242df740348b.
